data.long_meaning: Nafisah is a name derived from the Arabic word 'nafis', meaning precious or valuable. It is a beautiful name that symbolizes the value and worth of a person. The name Nafisah carries the meaning “Precious, valuable” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Nafisah usually hope their child will grow to embody precious, valuable and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Nafisah total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.

in_arabic.name: نفيسة
in_arabic.meaning: اسم يدل على الرفعة و العلو في الخُلُق و المكانة
in_arabic.long_meaning: نفيسة هو اسم علم مؤنث من أصل عربي و يعني الرفعة و العلو في الخُلُق و المكانة، و يوحي بالشرف و الرفاهية. و قد ورد ذكر اسم نفيسة في القرآن الكريم في سورة النور آية ٣٢، و هي من الأسماء التي تحمل معاني جميلة و رفيعة.

in_urdu.name: نفیسہ
in_urdu.meaning: رفیع و عالی قدر، شریف و باہ شان
in_urdu.long_meaning: نفیسہ ایک عربی نام ہے جس کا مطلب ہے رفیع و عالی قدر، شریف و باہ شان۔ یہ نام اسلامی تقویم میں اہم سمجھا جاتا ہے کیونکہ یہ قرآن مجید میں سورة النور میں ذکر ہوا ہے۔ اس نام کی لڑکیوں کو شریف، رفیع، اور اعلیٰ سمجھا جاتا ہے۔

in_hindi.name: नफ़ीसा
in_hindi.meaning: उच्च और उत्कृष्ट, श्रेष्ठ और महान
in_hindi.long_meaning: नफ़ीसा एक सुंदर और अर्थपूर्ण नाम है जो अरबी भाषा से लिया गया है। इसका अर्थ है उच्च और उत्कृष्ट, श्रेष्ठ और महान। यह नाम इस्लामी परंपरा में बहुत महत्व रखता है और अक्सर महान और आदरणीय महिलाओं को दिया जाता है।

in_pashto.name: نفيسه
in_pashto.meaning: لوړه او ویاړلیکه، شریفه او با شان
in_pashto.long_meaning: نفيسه د ښځو یو نوم دی چې په عربي ژبه کې رامینځته شوی دی. ددې نوم معنی لوړه او ویاړلیکه، شریفه او با شان ده. دا نوم په افغانستان کې د مسلمانو دودیزو نومونو په منځ کې ډیر مشهور دی.

in_english.name: Nafisah
in_english.meaning: Precious, noble, and exalted, signifying high status and dignity
in_english.long_meaning: Nafisah is a beautiful and meaningful name of Arabic origin, derived from the root 'n-f-s' which means 'precious' or 'noble'. It signifies high status, dignity, and exaltedness. In Islamic tradition, Nafisah is considered a blessed name, associated with positive qualities such as nobility, elegance, and refinement. Historically, the name Nafisah has been mentioned in the Quran (Surah An-Nur, Verse 32) and has been borne by several notable Muslim personalities throughout history.

The name has been bestowed upon numerous renowned figures in history, cementing its place as a respected and cherished name.
data.spiritual_significance: In the spiritual sense, the name Nafisah holds significant meaning for Muslims. It is a reminder of the inherent value and worth of every human being, as each person is a creation of Allah (God) and holds a special place in His sight. The name serves as a source of inspiration, encouraging one to strive for excellence in all areas of their life and fulfill their potential as a precious creation of Allah. It is also a reflection of the Quranic verse, "We have indeed Honor'd the Children of Adam" (Quran 17:70), which emphasizes the value and dignity of every human being.
